metric_notes.involvement_share: Of all the threat this player's team generated while he was on the pitch, the share he was involved in. Separates a side's main outlet from one contributor among many.
metric_notes.buildup_share: The same, counting only involvement before the shot or the pass that created it.
metric_notes.xGChain_90: Total xG of every possession this player was involved in, per 90 minutes.
metric_notes.xGBuildup_90: The same, excluding their own shots and key passes - involvement in building the move rather than finishing it.
metric_notes.final_third_90: Possession involvement minus build-up involvement: how much of their contribution comes at the sharp end.
metric_notes.npxG_per_shot: Average quality of the chances they get on the ball.
metric_notes.xA_per_key_pass: Average quality of the chances they create for others.
metric_notes.finishing_90: Non-penalty goals minus non-penalty xG, per 90. Positive means finishing above the quality of chances taken.
